name: Natsumi Fujiwara
bio: Natsumi Fujiwara (藤原 夏海, Fujiwara Natsumi, born June 2, 1994) is a Japanese voice actress from Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture. She is managed by the agency Arts Vision. She graduated from Nihon Narration Engi Kenkyujo (Japan Narration Acting Institute) in the same class as Kaede Hondo. In her second year since her debut, she played her first leading role as Chihiro Komiya in the 2016 tv anime Shonen Maid. In 2021, she won the Best New Actress Award at the 15th Seiyu Awards. Her hobbies and special skills are singing, playing catch, high bar (artistic gymnastics), and kendama.
